item.title: Columbia County school board approves 2026 leadership roles, recognizes Greenbrier girls flag football
item.description: The Columbia County Board of Education held its first regular session of the year on Tuesday at the Columbia County Board of Education building. The post Columbia County school board approves 2026 leadership roles, recognizes Greenbrier girls flag football appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Sheriff Whittle looks back on deadly stop & debunks ATF-waiting narrative
item.description: Columbia County Sheriff Clay Whittle is pushing back against suggestions that his command staff was weighing whether to delay action against James Blake Montgomery in favor of a federal SWAT operation last April, saying his agency was under a direct court order to act. The post Sheriff Whittle looks back on deadly stop & debunks ATF-waiting narrative appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta weighs $2M fast track for Broad as nine parks face sale
item.description: Augusta commissioners are considering a $2 million incentive to accelerate construction of the Broad Street improvements project. The post Augusta weighs $2M fast track for Broad as nine parks face sale appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Long-withheld NDA agreement for Appling data center property shows no trade secrets
item.description: The nondisclosure agreement (NDA) between Atlanta developer Trammell Crow Co. and Columbia County was released Monday after months of attempts—including by local group Citizens for Open Governance and even by TAP—to retrieve the document via open records requests (ORR). The post Long-withheld NDA agreement for Appling data center property shows no trade secrets appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta senator releases statement on gun bill addendum
item.description: Senate Minority Leader Harold Jones II, D-Augusta, released a statement Tuesday on a proposed Senate amendment he said restricts local governments’ ability to regulate the storage of firearms. The post Augusta senator releases statement on gun bill addendum appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Martinez teen accused of molesting girl for years
item.description: A Martinez teen is accused of sex acts on a girl that started when he was 12 and the girl was 8. The post Martinez teen accused of molesting girl for years appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Three more suspects charged in 2023 murder in Aiken County
item.description: Three more people have been arrested or charged in connection with the 2023 shooting death of 20-year-old Jatavious Harris of Batesburg, according to Aiken County authorities. The post Three more suspects charged in 2023 murder in Aiken County appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Murder suspect wanted in New York arrested after SWAT standoff in Augusta
item.description: Two people were arrested Tuesday after a barricaded suspect incident involving a murder suspect wanted out of New York, according to Richmond County Sheriff’s Office Chief of Staff Lewis Blanchard. The post Murder suspect wanted in New York arrested after SWAT standoff in Augusta appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Helene recovery: Augusta reimbursed $42.8 million as total costs near $88.4 million
item.description: Augusta officials released an update Wednesday on the city’s recovery from Hurricane Helene, reporting almost half of the government’s storm-related expenses has been reimbursed. The post Helene recovery: Augusta reimbursed $42.8 million as total costs near $88.4 million appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Hearings for three data center rezonings to begin
item.description: Columbia County’s new Data Center (D-C) district zoning is getting its first hearings, tonight, as the Columbia County Planning Commission hears three separate rezoning requests for large, neighboring rural tracts to make way for data facility development. The post Hearings for three data center rezonings to begin appeared first on The Augusta Press.
